Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Fairfax for 2026, and here is what he found: 8 family events, 4 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Holiday Tree Lighting at the Mosaic District) through December 26, with the Festival of Lights and Carols in Downtown Fairfax (December 5), Breakfast with Santa at Dave and Buster's (December 5), the 10th Annual Fairfax Holiday Market (December 4 to 13), Winter Wonderland at Burke Lake Park (December 5 to 20) and the Nutcracker with the Fairfax Symphony and Fairfax Ballet (December 19 and 20) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Fairfax

  • 8 Christmas events for kids in Fairfax
  • 4 free events, including the Holiday Tree Lighting, the Festival of Lights and Carols in Downtown Fairfax, the 10th Annual Fairfax Holiday Market and Holiday Songs and Winter Stories at the library
  • Meet Santa: Holiday Tree Lighting (November 27), Festival of Lights and Carols (December 5), Breakfast with Santa at Dave and Buster's (December 5), the Fairfax Holiday Market (Santa photos December 6) and Santa Photos at Springfield Town Center (through December 24)
  • Tree lightings and music: Holiday Tree Lighting (November 27), the Festival of Lights and Carols tree lighting (December 5) and the Nutcracker with the Fairfax Symphony and Fairfax Ballet (December 19 and 20)
  • Markets: the 10th Annual Fairfax Holiday Market at Old Town Square (December 4 to 13)
  • Season: November 27 to December 26

Planning a bigger day out? Fairfax families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Washington, DC, which covers ZooLights, the National Christmas Tree and the Nutcracker at the Warner Theatre.
